text: A failed cooling pump caused the outage at the Ruvenna data centre last spring, knocking several municipal and business systems offline for hours, according to a post-incident review released Tuesday by the city of Brackenport. The review said the pump seized on April 18, triggering an automatic shutdown to protect servers from overheating. Power was not lost, but backup cooling systems did not fully engage, leaving the facility unable to restore normal service until technicians replaced the unit and cleared heat damage from two adjoining racks. “The failure was mechanical, not cyber-related, and it has since been addressed,” said Miren Vale, Brackenport’s director of digital infrastructure. City officials said the outage affected 14 agencies and delayed online payments.
